name: csv-extractor
description: A script to convert OFX files downloaded from financial institutions into CSV files formatted for import into Simplifi

scripts.all_in_one: tsc --p tsconfig.json && node ./dist/all_in_one.js && npm run parser && npm run remove_duplicate_transactions && npm run archive && npm run copy_empty_templates
scripts.parser_using_date: echo 'enter date range start yyyy-mm-dd (blank for oldest)' && read start_date && echo 'enter date range end yyyy-mm-dd (blank for most recent)' && read end_date && default_start_date="${start_date:-default_date}"; default_end_date="${end_date:-default_date}" && npm run parser $default_start_date $default_end_date

author: Randy Beard
